bullets.text: Residents in Velachery reported severe mosquito nuisance at a major mall in the 174th ward under Adyar zone, and the office should inspect sanitation measures.
Migrant workers in Ponneri fell ill after eating mushrooms, and the district team should monitor their medical treatment and food safety standards.
Commuters in Thiruvallur urged that the Chennai to Arakkonam suburban express train be operated with 12 coaches, and the office should track railway representations.
Authorities removed encroaching shops on the Thiruvallur temple chariot street following a news report, and the office should watch for further public space clearances.
Bihar targeted AI training for five lakh youth under its proposed policy, and our portfolio team should review similar skill development initiatives in Tamil Nadu.
Commentators stressed the urgency for a well-armed AI defence force with tiered access rules, and the office should monitor emerging national security frameworks.
